node_8.description: This is Arthur Burton's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 8:00 am, have breakfast at 8:30 am, spend time researching mixology techniques and experimenting with new cocktail recipes from 9:00 am to 12:00 pm, take a break and enjoy a light lunch at 12:30 pm, prepare and organize the bar for the evening rush from 1:00 pm to 4:00 pm, have dinner at 4:00 pm, unwind and relax with a short walk or some light reading from 4:30 pm to 5:00 pm, open The Rose and Crown Pub at 5:00 pm.
